x-repost.cadence_contract: one hourly pass publishes at most one post from @selawmqt, or records why it published none
x-repost.notes: First loop ported to this repo. Runs from ~/loops/current, state in ~/loops/x-repost.

cfo-hourly.cadence_contract: one hourly pass appends at most one redacted CFO result and delivers at most one daily snapshot, or records a failure
cfo-hourly.notes: Stable release runs from ~/.local/share/life-manager/cfo-hourly/current; no account balances or provider secrets are stored in the registry.
